titulo: What do you want on Alumia?
chamada: Five quick questions. With them, the In a circle feed puts first, in each 6-hour block, what has to do with you. Nothing disappears: only the order changes.
aparelho: Your answers stay only on this device. On each read, the feed receives your interests as a filter and the server keeps nothing. Change or delete them whenever you want, in Settings.

objetivos.titulo: What did you come here for?
objetivos.ajuda: Mark as many as you want.

pautas.ajuda: Each cause brings its #topics to the top of the block.

estudos.ajuda: If it does not apply, just skip.

ritmo.ajuda: It only changes when the "While you were away" strip appears.

atos.texto: What is going to happen and where

amizades.texto: Talking with people who fight alongside

estudo.texto: ENEM, entrance exams, political education, reading

conversa.texto: Everything in the circle, including loose conversations between a few people.

conteudo.texto: Side conversations from people you don't follow move to the end of the block. They don't disappear.

pouco.texto: I drop by now and then. The strip of what arrived appears after 24 hours away.

medio.texto: The strip appears after 8 hours away.

muito.texto: I'm always around. The strip appears after 4 hours away.

resumo.titulo: This is how your feed looks
resumo.nada: Nothing marked that changes the order: your feed is the same as everyone's.
resumo.conteudo: Side conversations from people you don't follow move to the end of the block.
resumo.ritmo: The "While you were away" strip appears after {horas} hours away.

ajustes.texto: What you marked in the questionnaire. It stays only on this device and changes the order of the In a circle feed.
ajustes.vazio: You haven't answered yet, or you deleted your answers. Your feed is the same as everyone's.
ajustes.outroAparelho: On another device, the answers don't show up: answer again there, if you want.

cadastro.titulo: Before sending: what do you want on Alumia?
cadastro.nota: Optional. It does not go with your request: it stays only on this device.
cadastro.pronto: Interests saved on this device. Now just send the request.
cadastro.pulado: Questionnaire skipped. You can answer later, in Settings.
